# RavenArc

> RavenArc is an independent publication on strategy and consequential decisions for chief executives, boards and senior leaders. Founded and edited by Ishan Kashyap. Every piece shows its sources and states what would change our view.

## Topics
- [Corporate strategy](https://ravenarcgroup.com/topics/corporate-strategy): where to compete (new writing in preparation)
- [M&A and investment](https://ravenarcgroup.com/topics/mergers-and-acquisitions): why mergers fail, deal theses, valuation
- [Operating model and transformation](https://ravenarcgroup.com/topics/operating-model): operating model design, OKRs vs KPIs
- [Supply chain](https://ravenarcgroup.com/topics/supply-chain): resilience without sacrificing margin, demand sensing
- [AI strategy](https://ravenarcgroup.com/topics/ai-strategy): AI strategy for CEOs, AI as an operating-model question
- [Marketing analytics](https://ravenarcgroup.com/topics/marketing-analytics): marketing ROI, marketing mix modelling, commercial data for public health in India
- [Sports business and analytics](https://ravenarcgroup.com/topics/sports-business): IPL franchise valuation, auction strategy, the RCB sale
